retrospective_comparison.scope: same 12 fixture cases and same local observations used for calibration; no generalized gain or independent prediction test
retrospective_comparison.failed_method_policy: elapsed remains null and cannot be recommended when any replicate fails
retrospective_comparison.timing_scope: One deterministic propose_plans call; input construction excluded from comparison_wall_s but included in total_pilot_wall_s.

timing_scope: setup plus verification runs plus report construction; excludes final serialization and host assessment
timing_breakdown: wall_s includes method preparation and supervising source guards; step durations include subprocess execution and postchecks; non_unittest_wall_s includes preparation, startup, serialization and all Conductor overhead, not separately instrumented

prior_pilot_iterations.superseded_reason: Added supervising-source guards, per-method preparation timing, and an observed retrospective comparator. Prior source tree and snapshot hashes both matched; original run evidence retained.

development_failures.reason: platform.platform() tried a metadata subprocess during preview; replaced by sys.platform and all later runs passed

contract_validation.measurement_scope: The contract suite includes one paired smoke comparison per invocation; these development observations are excluded from calibrated medians and were not retained as independent pilot evidence.

common_driver_overhead_scope: Residual includes initial supervising-module import, comparison, result collection and report construction. The first supervising import precedes method wall_s; it remains included in total_pilot_wall_s. No separately measured host/tool/model overhead.

independent_review.scope: read-only pilot implementation, source bindings, measurement truthfulness and final evidence
independent_review.fixed_finding: Require actual supervising source hashes before and after dispatch as well as unchanged copied worker sources.
